messages:
Sam: Heads-up — friend dropping by ~4:30pm with two boxed e-bikes and a folded electric scooter. They asked if we can accept oversized packages and print a temp badge. :bike:
Front Desk: Okay — can you share visitor name and phone? Also note: building requires freight elevator for large crates and battery policy applies.
Sam: Name's Leo Martinez, phone 555-1212. Boxes labeled 'E-Mobility Ltd'. Driver said ETA 4:20-4:30.
Delivery-Bot: Delivery notice received at 16:14 for 3 parcels (oversized). Driver requests loading dock ramp. Freight elevator recommended.
Front Desk: We'll meet in lobby. Pre-printing a temp badge. Booking freight elevator now.
Building Security: Reserving freight elevator 16:15-16:45. Driver must show company ID and sign waiver at reception. Reminder: no unattended lithium batteries in public areas.
Eve: Quick policy reminder — any detachable lithium battery must be removed from the vehicle before leaving on site. We cannot store batteries overnight. If batteries are present and driver won't take them, we can place them in secure holding for up to 2 hours only.
Sam: Thanks — I'll ask Leo to have the batteries removed before bringing bikes inside. He might need help carrying the boxes up a few steps.
Front Desk: Badge to be printed as follows:
```
Visitor: Leo Martinez
Company: E-Mobility Ltd
Badge: TEMP-LEO-430
Notes: 2 e-bikes + scooter (oversized). Freight elevator reserved. Batteries handled per policy.
```
Front Desk: We'll lay down floor protectors by the bench and put a small ramp mat at the threshold.
Priya: I can be lobby escort at 4:25 and help wheel the boxes up. No wheel marks on the new tiles, promise :sweat_smile:.
Sam: Legend, thank you. If security flags anything about battery paperwork, ping me and I'll sort with Leo.
Front Desk: All set — driver told to come to loading dock, meet receptionist, sign waiver. Badge printed and in the A-desk tray.
Building Security: Noted. Driver should be ready to show company manifest. If anything looks noncompliant we'll refuse entry per building rules.
Sam: Appreciated. I'll be there at 4:20 to meet them. Will update if arrival shifts. :thumbsup:
